methods.sft: First practical candidate because correct typed intent and evidence-grounded answers can be demonstrated, and published Ling attention-LoRA support exists. This is a low-cost starting hypothesis, not proof SFT beats RL.
methods.attention_only: Freeze routed/shared experts, router gate, embeddings and output head; explicit KDA/MLA projections appropriate to backend. Cloud reference rank16/alpha32/dropout0.05. Initial pilot LR1e-5 is a proposed conservative setting to qualify; one configuration, no hyperparameter sweep within $30. Local feasibility candidate rank8,last4layers,LR1e-5 per report.
methods.verified_rejection_sft: On training split only, sample at most4 candidates with current policy/open teacher, keep exact independent-verifier successes; log acceptance by family. Abort empty/collapsed acceptance; do not replace gold with plausible teacher output.
methods.rl: Routing has parser-decidable reward; GRPO/RLOO are appropriate later contenders if exact verifier reliable and Ling log-probability/backward/serving path qualified. Binary full correctness after strict safety/literal/schema gates, not format-only orsource-only reward. Use development selection, never sealed final rewards. No reliable model-specific cheap RL runtime established here.
methods.dpo: For answer readability/preferences only afterboth responses factual/equally scoped, human/independent reviewed pairs; reward cannot legitimize invented counts or denial-as-empty.
methods.not_proposed: No full7.9B parameter training, expert tuning, broad pretrained-base restart or knowledge installation claim. No local GRPO default.

full_finetune_memory_correction: Memory depends on7.9B total parameters, not1.3B active per token. Full FP16 AdamW needs all weights, gradients and optimizer states; ordinary mixed-precision implementations can approach roughly100GiB or more before activations and runtime buffers. Exact implementation-dependent total is unmeasured. It is far beyond24GiB, so do not start the screenshot configuration. Attention-LoRA freezes base weights and limits optimizer states to adapters; published29GiB device use is a reference, not A6000 or Mac fit proof.
checkpoint_control_correction: Original installed oQ6e exact loaded checkpoint binding remains unverified. Cloud training uses a pinned official BF16 checkpoint. Compare untrained same official base, trained high-precision artifact, and both untrained/trained exports through identical Mac quantization/serving settings to separate training, quantization and checkpoint differences. Do not call an official-base versus unknown oQ6e difference training gain.
